name: tldv-recording-downloader
description: Browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) to download your own tl;dv meeting recordings as .ts or .mp4

scripts.lint:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && npx -y web-ext@8 lint --self-hosted --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.sign:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && npx -y web-ext@8 sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted && node scripts/firefox-release.mjs
